summary: Drugs Made In America Acquisition Corp. (a SPAC) filed an 8-K updating compensation arrangements: a revised Statement of Work for CFO Saleem Elmasri (from Titan Advisory Services) increasing his share grant to 175,000 ordinary shares (earned upon definitive agreement, issued at business combination close) and a CEO Compensation Agreement with Roger Bendelac (via Aleutian Equity Holdings) for $4,500/month ($2,500 current, up to $2,000 deferred). No acquisition, divestiture, or special-situation transaction is announced; this is an ordinary compensation update for a blank-check company. No deal terms are stated.
